# External-source provenance and extraction counts

`extraction_generated_counts_20261117.csv` preserves the frozen report's qualified-facet generation/rejection/extra counts.

The original Petrov et al. `intercorrs.csv` is not distributed here. Figure5.1 now uses [PHG's cited table of published coefficients](../../published/README.md). Its original source identity is Petrov, Serapio-García & Rentfrow (2024), arXiv:2405.07248, repository `nikbpetrov/LLMs-Simulate-Humans`, commit `85c3c2f78d5371cf16b71b8b94006d379b4c24fd`, path `data/data_for_R/intercorrs.csv`, SHA256 `aa55c342bd2ee55ba111927e3f31a71ec8f702a692da4b5ec4cb46db97224e0c`. `scripts/download_petrov.py` remains an optional route to that original file; it is not a READER dependency. Published values retain their original credit and are not relicensed by PHG.
